title: settlement.clawback_created
description: Reversing a settled bet took more than the player's cash: the rest is owed on PLAYER_DEBT, never negative cash (C10 §5). Published by the settlement module on NATS subject evt.settlement.clawback_created (version 1), with the reversal. Consumers: C13, C15 (a finance case). This is the `data` payload; the envelope is TD-02 §5. Ids and santim only. New fields are additive only.

debt_santim.description: Debited to the player's PLAYER_DEBT because their cash couldn't cover the reversal (C03 §4)
